headline: BOND 🔥 MARKET 🏦 WILDFIRE 🌋 Keeping 🌍 LEADERS 😱 Up 🛏️ At 🌙 NIGHT 🌃

But ❌ that ❌ has ❌ not ❌ happened ❌ leaving 🏦 markets 💱 pricing 📉 in 🛢️ higher 📈 energy ⚡ prices 📉 a 🏜️ chronic 🏜️ Gulf 🌊 crisis 🌋 higher 📈 inflation 📈 for ⏳ longer ⏳ and 🔄 so 🏦 higher 📈 interest 📈 rates 📊!! But 🧠 that 🧠 is 🧠 only 🧠 part 📦 of 🧠 the 🧠 story 📖 as 🏦 big 📈 demand 📈 for 🏦 borrowing 🏦 across 🌍 the 🌍 world 🌍 keeps 🏦 climbing 🧗‍♂️.

The 🧨 bigger 📈 picture 🖼️ is 📈 rising 📈 demand 📈 for 🏦 borrowing 🏦 across 🌍 the 🌍 world 🌍 and 🏦 not 🛑 just 🏛️ from 👑 governments 🏛️!! Big 📱 tech 💻 companies 🏢 are 🔄 turning 🔄 to 🏦 the 🏦 same 🏦 bond 🧾 markets 🏪 to 💰 raise 💰 hundreds 💰 of 💰 billions 💰 of 💰 dollars 💵 for 🧠 investments 🏗️ in 🤖 AI 🤖 data 🗄️ centres 🏗️!! Over 💰 two 💰 hundred 💰 nineteen 💰 billion 💰 of 🏦 debt 🏦 has 🏦 already 🏦 been 🏦 issued 📤 this 🗓️ year 🗓️ by 🏦 the 🏦 US 🦅 hyperscalers 🖥️ such 🤖 as 🤖 Google 🧠 Amazon 📦 and 📦 Meta 👓 nearly 📊 a 📊 third 📊 of 📊 it 📊 in 🪙 currencies 🪙 other 🪙 than 🪙 the 🪙 dollar 🪙 including 💷 sterling 💷!! The 🗓️ total 📊 issued 📤 last 🗓️ year 🗓️ was 💰 ninety 💰 three 💰 billion 💰 while 🗓️ before 🗓️ that 🗓️ it 🗓️ averaged 📉 less 📉 than 📉 forty 💰 billion 💰 a 🗓️ year 🗓️!! Some 🧠 expect 🤖 the 🤖 tech 🤖 giants 🤖 to 🤖 raise 🤖 four 🤖 hundred 🤖 to 🤖 five 🤖 hundred 🤖 billion 🤖 from 🏦 the 🏦 bond 🏦 markets 🏪 this 🗓️ year 🗓️!! These 🧨 are 🧨 staggering 🧨 sums 🧨 raising 🏦 competition 🥊 in 🏦 the 🏦 market 🏪 and 🏦 pushing 📈 up 📈 the 📈 price 📈 for 🏛️ governments 🏛️ to 🏦 borrow 🏦.

Looking 🧭 east 🌅 there 🌅 is 🌅 another 🌅 major 🌅 borrower 🌅 Japan 🇯🇵!! It 🇯🇵 has 🇯🇵 the 🇯🇵 highest 📈 debt 🏦 burden 🏋️ relative 📊 to 📊 its 📊 GDP 📊 of 📊 the 📊 major 🏆 economies 🏦 and 🏦 is 🏦 the 🏦 biggest 🏆 single 🏆 lender 🏦 to 🦅 the 🦅 US 🦅 government 🏛️!! Until 🕒 recently 🕒 its 🏦 central 🏦 bank's 🏦 interest 📈 rate 📈 was 📈 zero 0️⃣ but 📈 that 📈 has 📈 crept 📈 up 📈 to 📈 help 🛠️ combat ⚔️ rising 📈 inflation 📈!! As 📉 a 📉 result 📉 its 📉 government 🏛️ bond 🧾 yields 📈 have 📈 been 📈 pushed 📈 to 📈 thirty 🕒 year 🗓️ highs 🏔️!! The 📉 declining 📉 value 📉 of 📉 the 📉 yen 💴 complicates 🧩 things 🧩 but 🧩 the 🧩 bottom 🧩 line 🧩 is 🧩 there 🧩 is 🧩 a 🧩 change 🔄 afoot 👣 in 🌍 the 🌍 global 🌍 flow 🌊 of 🌊 money 💰!! UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 borrowing 🏦 costs 💰 are 🏦 rising 📈 because 🧠 of 🧠 credibility 🧠 doubts ❓ over 📜 Burnham's 📜 broader 🧭 plans 🧭 as 📉 the 📉 brutal 📉 market 📉 equation 📉 says 📉 if 📉 a 📉 country 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 wants 🏦 to 🏦 borrow 🏦 more ➕ without 📉 a 📉 credible 📉 plan 📉 especially 📉 if 📉 there 📉 are 📉 doubts ❓ over 📉 the 📉 stability 🧱 of 📉 a 📉 given 📉 government 🏛️ then 📉 it 📉 should 📉 expect 📉 to 📉 pay 📉 a 📉 higher 📈 rate 📈!!

Influential 📢 economists 🧠 lean 🧱 on 📢 different 📢 factors 📢!! Mohamed 🧔 el 🧔 Erian 🧔 told 🗣️ me 🧔 the 🤖 AI 🤖 competition 🥊 in 🏦 bond 🏦 markets 🏪 was 🏦 the 🏦 biggest 🏆 new 🆕 factor 🧠!! Lord 👑 Jim 👑 O'Neill 👑 says 🗣️ the 🗣️ recent 🗓️ action ⚔️ has ⚔️ been ⚔️ caused ⚔️ by ⚔️ uncertainty ❓ about 🦅 US 🦅 policy 📜 and 📜 in 📜 particular 📜 efforts 📜 by 📜 the 📜 US 🦅 Government 🏛️ to 📉 try 📉 to 📉 manage 📉 down 📉 surging 📈 yields 📈!! This 🔄 brings 🔄 us 🔄 to 🔄 the 🔄 UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿!! The 🔄 profound 🔄 and 🔄 rolling 🔄 instability 🔄 of 🔄 multiple 👥 prime 👑 ministers 👑 chancellors 💼 policy 🔄 U-turns 🔄 and 🔄 the 🔄 seeming 🔄 inability ❌ to 🔄 push 🔄 through 🔄 major 🏗️ structural 🏗️ change 🔄 in 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 this 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 country 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 over 🕒 the 🕒 past 🕒 decades 🕒 has 🕒 attracted 🧲 a 🧲 premium 💰!! It 🏛️ was 🏛️ part 🏛️ of 🏛️ Sir 🏛️ Keir 🏛️ Starmer's 🏛️ strategy 🧠 to 🧠 try 🧠 to 🧠 take 🧠 on 🧠 boring 🧱 reforms 🧱 and 🧱 offer 🧱 markets 🏪 stability 🧱 in 🧱 a 🧱 bid 🧱 to 🧱 lower 📉 borrowing 🏦 costs 🏦!! It 🏛️ was 🏛️ a 🏛️ shock 😱 to 🏛️ many 🏛️ in 🏛️ the 🏛️ markets 🏪 that 🏛️ despite 🏛️ a 🏛️ landslide 🪨 majority 🏛️ Labour 🏛️ could 🏛️ not 🏛️ push 🏛️ through 🏛️ plans 🏛️ to 🏛️ cut ✂️ Britain's 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 welfare 🏥 bill 💰!! This 🏛️ added ➕ to 🏛️ the 🏛️ ups 📈 and 🏛️ downs 📉 in 🏛️ the 🏛️ gilt 🪙 markets 🏪 the 🏛️ trade 🛍️ in 🏛️ British 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 government 🏛️ debt 🏦!!
